title: Mystic Sorceress Summoning
description: A female elf-like sorceress with long flowing pink hair stands dynamically in the center, holding a glowing green crystal staff in her right hand while her left hand directs a swirling purple and blue magical tornado containing green crystals and pink butterflies. Silhouetted dark figures with glowing hands appear to the left as the dramatic sky swirls with storm clouds and lightning above a distant castle.
